description: Complete the act: pass act, the BODY_JSON from prepare_net_work_order UNCHANGED and the signature your wallet produced over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN. Relays to the same public door any HTTP client uses (POST /labor/net/work-orders, or its /:id/link, /:id/renew and /:id/withdraw); this server holds no keys and no funds, and the door checks the signature itself and keeps its own free daily limit for one connection. Free with a valid body-bound signature from the holder wallet. A work order moves no NET and holds none, and no job is posted, claimed, accepted or paid by it. The program is held off until the operator switches it on; the house pays, holds and sells nothing through this tool. Ask net_work_order_status where a work order stands, because Vealth sends no email. Cost and signer: free, no gas; signed by the person's own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.
